existing_exact_apis.name: localPair
existing_exact_apis.declaration: def localPair (b x a c : Int) : Int := (x+a)%b + (x+c)%b

existing_exact_apis.name: localPair_eq_zero_iff
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem localPair_eq_zero_iff (b x a c : Int) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2*b-2)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1) (hc : 0 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ 1) :
    localPair b x a c = 0 ↔
      (x=0 ∧ a=0 ∧ c=0) ∨
      (x=b ∧ a=0 ∧ c=0) ∨
      (x=b-1 ∧ a=1 ∧ c=1)

existing_exact_apis.name: localPair_eq_max_iff
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem localPair_eq_max_iff (b x a c : Int) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2*b-2)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1) (hc : 0 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ 1) :
    localPair b x a c = 2*b-2 ↔
      (x=b-1 ∧ a=0 ∧ c=0) ∨
      (x=b-2 ∧ a=1 ∧ c=1) ∨
      (x=2*b-2 ∧ a=1 ∧ c=1)

existing_exact_apis.name: births_have_interior_sources
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem births_have_interior_sources (b x a c : Int) (hb : 3 ≤ b)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2*b-2)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1) (hc : 0 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ 1)
    (hnew : (localPair b x a c = 0 ∧ x ≠ 0) ∨
      (localPair b x a c = 2*b-2 ∧ x ≠ 2*b-2)) :
    0 < x ∧ x < 2*b-2

existing_exact_apis.name: binary_extremes_swap
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem binary_extremes_swap :
    localPair 2 0 1 1 = 2 ∧ localPair 2 2 0 0 = 0

existing_exact_apis.name: incoming
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
def incoming (b : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool)) (k : Nat) : Int :=
  terminal b 0 (ordinaryTags (xs.take k))

existing_exact_apis.name: ordinary_body_at
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem ordinary_body_at (b i : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool)) (k : Nat)
    (hk : k < xs.length) :
    (body b i (ordinaryTags xs))[k]'(by simpa [body_length,ordinaryTags] using hk) =
      (xs[k].1 + terminal b i (ordinaryTags (xs.take k)))%b

existing_exact_apis.name: incoming_bit
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem incoming_bit (b : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool)) (k : Nat)
    (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hbound : Bounded b xs) :
    0 ≤ incoming b xs k ∧ incoming b xs k ≤ 1

existing_exact_apis.name: pairs_at
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem pairs_at (ds : List Int) (k : Nat) (hk : k < ds.length) :
    (pairs ds)[k]'(by rw [pairs_length]; exact hk) =
      ds[k] + ds[ds.length-1-k]'(by omega)

existing_exact_apis.name: symmetric_coefficient_at
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem symmetric_coefficient_at (xs : List (Int × Bool)) (k : Nat)
    (hk : k < xs.length) (hs : (xs.map Prod.fst).reverse = xs.map Prod.fst) :
    xs[xs.length-1-k].1 = xs[k].1

existing_exact_apis.name: actual_nooverflow_pair_at
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem actual_nooverflow_pair_at (b : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool)) (k : Nat)
    (hn : terminal b 0 (ordinaryTags xs) = 0) (hk : k < xs.length)
    (hs : (xs.map Prod.fst).reverse = xs.map Prod.fst) :
    (pairs (actualDigits b xs))[k]'(by
      rw [pairs_length,actual_nooverflow_length b xs hn]; exact hk) =
      localPair b xs[k].1 (incoming b xs k) (incoming b xs (xs.length-1-k))

existing_exact_apis.name: canonical_reverse_add_extremes
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem canonical_reverse_add_extremes (b : Int) (digits : List Int)
    (xs : List (Int × Bool)) (k : Nat) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hd : DigitBounds b digits) (hp : PositiveLast digits)
    (hqs : xs.map Prod.fst = pairs digits)
    (hn : terminal b 0 (ordinaryTags xs) = 0) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    let output := actualDigits b xs
    let x := xs[k].1
    let a := incoming b xs k
    let c := incoming b xs (xs.length-1-k)
    (∀ d ∈ output, 0 ≤ d ∧ d < b) ∧ PositiveLast output ∧
    SignedDigitUniqueness.eval b output =
      SignedDigitUniqueness.eval b digits + reversedValue b digits ∧
    ((pairs output)[k]'(by
      rw [pairs_length,actual_nooverflow_length b xs hn]; exact hk) = 0 ↔
      (x=0 ∧ a=0 ∧ c=0) ∨ (x=b ∧ a=0 ∧ c=0) ∨
      (x=b-1 ∧ a=1 ∧ c=1)) ∧
    ((pairs output)[k]'(by
      rw [pairs_length,actual_nooverflow_length b xs hn]; exact hk) = 2*b-2 ↔
      (x=b-1 ∧ a=0 ∧ c=0) ∨ (x=b-2 ∧ a=1 ∧ c=1) ∨
      (x=2*b-2 ∧ a=1 ∧ c=1))

existing_exact_apis.name: terminal
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
def terminal (b i : Int) : List (Int × Bool) → Int
  | [] => i
  | (q,r)::xs => terminal b ((q + if r then 0 else i)/b) xs

existing_exact_apis.name: body
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
def body (b i : Int) : List (Int × Bool) → List Int
  | [] => []
  | (q,r)::xs =>
    let active := if r then 0 else i
    ((q+active)%b + if r then i else 0) :: body b ((q+active)/b) xs

existing_exact_apis.name: placed_body_terminal
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem placed_body_terminal (b i : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool)) :
    placed b i xs = body b i xs ++ [terminal b i xs]

existing_exact_apis.name: body_length
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem body_length (b i : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool)) :
    (body b i xs).length = xs.length

existing_exact_apis.name: terminal_bit
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem terminal_bit (b i : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool))
    (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hi : 0 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 1) (hbound : Bounded b xs) :
    terminal b i xs = 0 ∨ terminal b i xs = 1

existing_exact_apis.name: ordinary_bound
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem ordinary_bound (b : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool)) (h : Bounded b xs) :
    Bounded b (ordinaryTags xs)

existing_exact_apis.name: ordinary_qs
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem ordinary_qs (xs : List (Int × Bool)) :
    (ordinaryTags xs).map Prod.fst = xs.map Prod.fst

existing_exact_apis.name: atActualWidth
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
def atActualWidth (b : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool)) : List Int :=
  if terminal b 0 (ordinaryTags xs) = 0 then body b 0 xs else placed b 0 xs

existing_exact_apis.name: actualDigits
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
def actualDigits (b : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool)) : List Int :=
  atActualWidth b (ordinaryTags xs)

existing_exact_apis.name: ordinaryTags_idempotent
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem ordinaryTags_idempotent (xs : List (Int × Bool)) :
    ordinaryTags (ordinaryTags xs) = ordinaryTags xs

existing_exact_apis.name: PositiveLast
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
def PositiveLast (ds : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∃ front digit, ds = front ++ [digit] ∧ 0 < digit

existing_exact_apis.name: actual_digits_length
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem actual_digits_length (b : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool))
    (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hbound : Bounded b xs) :
    (actualDigits b xs).length = xs.length +
      (terminal b 0 (ordinaryTags xs)).toNat

existing_exact_apis.name: actual_digits_bounded
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem actual_digits_bounded (b : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool))
    (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hbound : Bounded b xs) :
    ∀ d ∈ actualDigits b xs, 0 ≤ d ∧ d < b

existing_exact_apis.name: canonical_normalization
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem canonical_normalization (b : Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool))
    (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hbound : Bounded b xs) (hp : PositiveTerminal xs) :
    (∀ d ∈ actualDigits b xs, 0 ≤ d ∧ d < b) ∧
    PositiveLast (actualDigits b xs) ∧
    (actualDigits b xs).length = xs.length +
      (terminal b 0 (ordinaryTags xs)).toNat ∧
    eval b (actualDigits b xs) = eval b (xs.map Prod.fst)

existing_exact_apis.name: pairs
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
def pairs (digits : List Int) : List Int :=
  List.zipWith (· + ·) digits digits.reverse

existing_exact_apis.name: DigitBounds
reversedValue
existing_exact_apis.declaration: def reversedValue (b : Int) (digits : List Int) : Int := eval b digits.reverse

existing_exact_apis.name: pairs_length
existing_exact_apis.declaration: theorem pairs_length (digits : List Int) : (pairs digits).length = digits.length

existing_exact_apis.name: pairs_symmetric
existing_exact_apis.declaration: theorem pairs_symmetric (digits : List Int) : (pairs digits).reverse = pairs digits

existing_exact_apis.name: pairs_bounds
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem pairs_bounds (b : Int) (digits : List Int) (hd : DigitBounds b digits) :
    ∀ q ∈ pairs digits, 0 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ 2*b-2

existing_exact_apis.name: tagged_pairs_bound
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem tagged_pairs_bound (b : Int) (digits : List Int) (xs : List (Int × Bool))
    (hd : DigitBounds b digits) (hqs : xs.map Prod.fst = pairs digits) : Bounded b xs

existing_exact_apis.name: reverse_add_normalization
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem reverse_add_normalization (b : Int) (digits : List Int)
    (xs : List (Int × Bool)) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hd : DigitBounds b digits) (hp : PositiveLast digits)
    (hqs : xs.map Prod.fst = pairs digits) :
    (∀ d ∈ actualDigits b xs, 0 ≤ d ∧ d < b) ∧
    PositiveLast (actualDigits b xs) ∧
    (actualDigits b xs).length = digits.length +
      (terminal b 0 (ordinaryTags xs)).toNat ∧
    eval b (actualDigits b xs) = eval b digits + reversedValue b digits

existing_exact_apis.name: canonical_input_positive
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem canonical_input_positive (b : Int) (digits : List Int) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hd : DigitBounds b digits) (hp : PositiveLast digits) : 0 < eval b digits

existing_exact_apis.name: tags
existing_exact_apis.declaration: def tags (q : List Int) : List (Int × Bool) := q.map (fun a => (a, false))

existing_exact_apis.name: normalize
existing_exact_apis.declaration: def normalize (b : Int) (q : List Int) : List Int := actualDigits b (tags q)

existing_exact_apis.name: nextPairs
existing_exact_apis.declaration: def nextPairs (b : Int) (q : List Int) : List Int := pairs (normalize b q)

existing_exact_apis.name: tags_projection
existing_exact_apis.declaration: @[simp] theorem tags_projection (q : List Int) : (tags q).map Prod.fst = q

existing_exact_apis.name: tags_ordinary
existing_exact_apis.declaration: @[simp] theorem tags_ordinary (q : List Int) : ordinaryTags (tags q) = tags q

existing_exact_apis.name: ordinaryStep
existing_exact_apis.declaration: def ordinaryStep (b : Int) (digits : List Int) : List Int := normalize b (pairs digits)

existing_exact_apis.name: ordinary_step_canonical
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem ordinary_step_canonical (b : Int) (digits : List Int) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hd : DigitBounds b digits) (hp : PositiveLast digits) :
    DigitBounds b (ordinaryStep b digits) ∧ PositiveLast (ordinaryStep b digits) ∧
      eval b (ordinaryStep b digits) = eval b digits + eval b digits.reverse

existing_exact_apis.name: digitOrbit
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
def digitOrbit (b : Int) (digits : List Int) : Nat → List Int
  | 0 => digits
  | t+1 => ordinaryStep b (digitOrbit b digits t)

/-- The usual first positive hitting time; time zero is deliberately excluded. -/

existing_exact_apis.name: digit_orbit_canonical
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem digit_orbit_canonical (b : Int) (digits : List Int) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hd : DigitBounds b digits) (hp : PositiveLast digits) (t : Nat) :
    DigitBounds b (digitOrbit b digits t) ∧ PositiveLast (digitOrbit b digits t)

existing_exact_apis.name: digit_orbit_value
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem digit_orbit_value (b : Int) (digits : List Int) (hb : 2 ≤ b)
    (hd : DigitBounds b digits) (hp : PositiveLast digits) (t : Nat) :
    0 < eval b (digitOrbit b digits t) ∧
    eval b (digitOrbit b digits (t+1)) =
      eval b (digitOrbit b digits t) + eval b (digitOrbit b digits t).reverse

existing_exact_apis.name: adjacent_residues_zero_iff
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem adjacent_residues_zero_iff (x y a b d e : Nat)
    (hx : x ≤ 18) (hy : y ≤ 18) (ha : a ≤ 1) (he : e ≤ 1)
    (hb : b = (x + a) / 10) (hd : d = (y + e) / 10) :
    (y + b) % 10 + (x + d) % 10 = 0 ↔
      (x = 0 ∧ y = 0) ∨
      (x = 9 ∧ y = 9 ∧ b = 1 ∧ d = 1) ∨
      (x = 9 ∧ y = 10 ∧ b = 0) ∨
      (x = 10 ∧ y = 9 ∧ d = 0)

existing_exact_apis.name: adjacent_residues_eighteen_iff
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem adjacent_residues_eighteen_iff (x y a b d e : Nat)
    (hx : x ≤ 18) (hy : y ≤ 18) (ha : a ≤ 1) (he : e ≤ 1)
    (hb : b = (x + a) / 10) (hd : d = (y + e) / 10) :
    (y + b) % 10 + (x + d) % 10 = 18 ↔
      (x = 18 ∧ y = 18) ∨
      (x = 9 ∧ y = 9 ∧ b = 0 ∧ d = 0) ∨
      (x = 9 ∧ y = 8 ∧ b = 1) ∨
      (x = 8 ∧ y = 9 ∧ d = 1)

existing_exact_apis.name: next_column_adjacent_residues
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem next_column_adjacent_residues (q : Nat → Nat) (L i : Nat)
    (hA : Admissible L q) (hi0 : 0 < i) (hi : i < L)
    (hc : carry q L = 1) :
    nextColumns q L i =
      (q i + carry q i) % 10 + (q (i - 1) + carry q (L - i)) % 10

existing_exact_apis.name: next_column_zero_iff
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem next_column_zero_iff (q : Nat → Nat) (L i : Nat)
    (hA : Admissible L q) (hi0 : 0 < i) (hi : i < L)
    (hc : carry q L = 1) :
    nextColumns q L i = 0 ↔
      (q (i - 1) = 0 ∧ q i = 0) ∨
      (q (i - 1) = 9 ∧ q i = 9 ∧ carry q i = 1 ∧ carry q (L - i) = 1) ∨
      (q (i - 1) = 9 ∧ q i = 10 ∧ carry q i = 0) ∨
      (q (i - 1) = 10 ∧ q i = 9 ∧ carry q (L - i) = 0)

existing_exact_apis.name: next_column_eighteen_iff
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem next_column_eighteen_iff (q : Nat → Nat) (L i : Nat)
    (hA : Admissible L q) (hi0 : 0 < i) (hi : i < L)
    (hc : carry q L = 1) :
    nextColumns q L i = 18 ↔
      (q (i - 1) = 18 ∧ q i = 18) ∨
      (q (i - 1) = 9 ∧ q i = 9 ∧ carry q i = 0 ∧ carry q (L - i) = 0) ∨
      (q (i - 1) = 9 ∧ q i = 8 ∧ carry q i = 1) ∨
      (q (i - 1) = 8 ∧ q i = 9 ∧ carry q (L - i) = 1)

existing_exact_apis.name: new_extreme_has_adjacent_nine
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem new_extreme_has_adjacent_nine (q : Nat → Nat) (L i : Nat)
    (hA : Admissible L q) (hi0 : 0 < i) (hi : i < L)
    (hc : carry q L = 1)
    (hnew : (nextColumns q L i = 0 ∧ ¬(q (i - 1) = 0 ∧ q i = 0)) ∨
      (nextColumns q L i = 18 ∧ ¬(q (i - 1) = 18 ∧ q i = 18))) :
    q (i - 1) = 9 ∨ q i = 9

existing_exact_apis.name: next_endpoints
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem next_endpoints (q : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat)
    (hA : Admissible L q) (hc : carry q L = 1) :
    nextColumns q L 0 = 1 + q 0 % 10 ∧
      nextColumns q L L = 1 + q 0 % 10

existing_exact_apis.name: next_endpoints_not_extreme
existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem next_endpoints_not_extreme (q : Nat → Nat) (L : Nat)
    (hA : Admissible L q) (hc : carry q L = 1) :
    nextColumns q L 0 ≠ 0 ∧ nextColumns q L 0 ≠ 18 ∧
      nextColumns q L L ≠ 0 ∧ nextColumns q L L ≠ 18

existing_exact_apis.declaration:
theorem binary_safety_boundary :
    pairs [0,1,1] = [1,2,1] ∧
    HighNeutral 2 (pairs [0,1,1]) ∧
    outgoing 2 (tags [1,2,1] true) 2 = 0 ∧

    actualDigits 2 (tags [1,2,1] true) = [1,0,0,1] ∧
    ([1,0,0,1] : List Int).reverse = [1,0,0,1]
